title: Hsevo: Elevating Automatic Heuristic Design with Diversity-Driven Harmony Search and Genetic Algorithm Using LLMs
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

publication.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-based heuristic design for online bin packing, TSP, and orienteering
mechanism.populationDetail: Maintains a flat heuristic population; reported size is 30 at initialization and 10 in other stages.
mechanism.archiveDetail: An elite heuristic is selected from within the population, but no separate search archive is described; the historical diversity archive stores all candidates for analysis.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Population size is stage-dependent and the paper does not specify which individuals are removed or replaced when the pool is bounded.
mechanism.generationDetail: Initialization revises a trivial seed; crossover fuses two parents, elitist mutation broadly revises one best heuristic, and Harmony Search locally tunes its parameters.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Feedback is LLM-generated from objective rankings, not a direct textual output of the objective evaluator; diversity indices are analysis metrics, not search feedback.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Two random population members are true crossover parents; the elite is selected for unary mutation and Harmony Search.

provenance.citationWarning: Replacement/survivor policy is not specified; the all-candidate diversity archive is for analysis, not an elite archive. Parent count varies by operator.
